title: Fisherman Installation Recipe
description: Schema for bootc-installer GUI-generated fisherman installation recipes

disk.description: Block device path (e.g. /dev/sda) for auto-partition, or empty for manual partitioning

btrfsSubvolumes.description: Create btrfs subvolumes (@, @home, @snapshots) when filesystem is btrfs

passphrase.description: Passphrase for LUKS encryption (required when type is luks-passphrase)

image.description: Source OCI image reference for installation

targetImgref.description: Update-tracking image reference (optional; defaults to image if unset)

selinuxDisabled.description: Disable SELinux in the installed system

composeFsBackend.description: Pass --composefs-backend to bootc install (requires fs-verity filesystem)

genericImage.description: Pass --generic-image to bootc install (skip bootupd checks)

zfsPoolName.description: ZFS pool name to create (only when filesystem is zfs)

flatpakVarPath.description: Path relative to root where flatpak /var lives

username.description: Username for the primary user account

keepExisting.description: Mount existing filesystem instead of formatting

additionalImageStores.description: Host paths to expose to bootc as additional image stores (for offline installs)

slurpWallpapers.description: Extract wallpapers from existing Windows partition

categories.description: Windows user data categories to migrate

targetMount.description: Host path where fisherman assembles the target filesystem (default: /mnt/fisherman-target)

luksMapperName.description: cryptsetup mapper name for LUKS root device (default: fisherman-root)

distroID.description: Short lowercase distro identifier for OEM paths/services (default: bootc)

brewTap.description: Homebrew tap to add before OEM package installation
